verdict.rationale: The register is machine-readable by design: every record has a unique URI retrievable by simple GET, and a live API returns structured JSON (an auth challenge on a keyless request), so a company's own filed data can be pulled programmatically with a free key. Nothing shows a bulk export of everything you have filed, document images in open formats, or a leave/offboarding path, and 'leaving' a statutory register is inherently limited. Missing for 10: documented complete per-user or per-company export, open-format document downloads, an exit/portability workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of full data extraction.
